system.description:
Inflicts pain and harm with needles of occult power: an instant Wrack in combat, or a slow Doom worked through a poppet.

Spell. Wrack: Will test against the target's Sorcery Defense, Close Range. Damage equal to Will × degrees, ignoring armor; trade a degree to deny the target's next Greater Action. Once paid for, keep wracking for the rest of the combat.

Ritual. Alignment: Doom: Challenging (9) Knowledge, 1 hour. Invocation: Formidable (12) Will, 6 hours. Unleashing: Will against the target's Sorcery Defense: slow, agonizing harm that can doom the victim to death.

Art of Malediction — full rules: Sword Chronicle p. 100.
system.resonances: None (spell), or a prepared poppet with a link to the target (ritual).
